name: reef
description: Reef workspaces for coding agents: the skill that starts work in an isolated workspace, and Reef's MCP server.

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: List the repositories registered with Reef, oldest first. Returns {repositories, next_page_token}.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List a repository's workspaces, newest first: each is a directory leased to one agent, editing one change, with how many files it changed. Returns {workspaces, next_page_token}.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Show a workspace: its directory, change, lease and recent snapshots. Returns the workspace as `reef ws inspect -o json` prints it.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Show what the workspace changes, after a snapshot, and the repository's state. Returns {repository_status, workspace_status}.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List changes, newest first, as `reef log` does. Returns {entries, at_operation, next_page_token}.

tools.name: get_change
tools.description: Show one change: its ids, description, parents and state, without its files (get_diff has them). Returns {change, at_operation}.

tools.name: get_diff
tools.description: A change's diff against its parents, or two revisions' diff, a page of files at a time. Returns {from_commit_ids, to_commit_id, files, symbol_summary, next_page_token}.

tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: List the repository's operation log, newest first: every snapshot, describe, edit and workspace change, by whom. Returns {operations, next_page_token}.

tools.name: query_changes
tools.description: Which changes touched these files or symbols: who wrote them, when, and whether they landed. Newest first. Returns {changes, coverage, next_page_token}.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Show one operation and what it changed (effects). Returns the operation.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file at any revision, one range at a time, without a directory; pass the first range's at_operation on to read one version. Returns {path, size, content (text) or content_base64, offset, next_offset}; next_offset is null at the end.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List a directory at any revision. Returns {entries, commit_id, at_operation, next_page_token}.

tools.name: wait_for_operations
tools.description: Wait until operations matching the filter are recorded (another agent's describe, edit or snapshot) or the timeout passes; over 60 s may hit the client's tool timeout. Returns {operations (oldest first, at most 100), last_operation_id, timed_out}; pass last_operation_id back as after_operation for the next ones.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create a workspace: a copy-on-write directory on a new change (or an existing one), snapshotted as it is written. Its lease is kept alive while the server runs; release_workspace it when done, or it is reclaimed with a final snapshot about 35 minutes after the server stops. Returns the workspace and its path.

tools.name: snapshot_workspace
tools.description: Record the workspace's files now, as its change's new commit. Returns {changed, commit_id, operation, workspace}.

tools.name: move_workspace
tools.description: Point a workspace at another change, or a new change on a revision, after a final snapshot of the one it leaves; its files are checked out again. Returns the workspace afterwards.

tools.name: release_workspace
tools.description: Take a final snapshot of a workspace and remove its directory; its change stays in the repository. Returns {id, final_op_id, snapshot_taken, freed_bytes}.

tools.name: describe_change
tools.description: Set a change's description (its commit message). Returns {change, operation, workspace}; operation is null when the description was already that.

tools.name: abandon_change
tools.description: Abandon a change: its descendants move onto its parents. Returns {abandoned_commit_id, operation, workspace}.

tools.name: undo_operation
tools.description: Revert what one operation did, as a new operation (list_operations lists them). Returns {operation, snapshot, undone_operation_id, workspace}.

tools.name: edit_files
tools.description: Write, replace text in, delete, copy or chmod files in a change (revision) or a new change (new_on), as one operation, without a directory; workspaces on the change get the new files. Rename: copy_from the old path, and delete it, in one call. Returns {change, operation, workspace}.
